what: A virtual analog synthesizer: three oscillators per voice, two multimode filters, three LFOs, a modulation matrix, up to 16 voices and two parts as layer or split. With effects and a shimmer reverb, an arpeggiator, a sequencer played from the keys and a drum machine.
author: J0KERPACK
